svg.title: Option A · Tabs and cards — Expert page, opened from the ‘expert ›’ link of a card (here Lens 2)
svg.text: Option A · Tabs and cards — Expert page, opened from the ‘expert ›’ link of a card (here Lens 2)
EMULATOR — rack IOC and HV IOC report mode sim. No hardware is connected.
Own route (/expert/au_lens2): opens in place, or in a second browser tab with middle-click. Generated from the registry for every device.
Why is it purple? INVALID since 14:02:11, STAT = TIMEOUT
Unit 5 has not answered a poll for 2 min 14 s. Lens 1 (unit 3) on the same chain answers, so the
chain CO-U32 (mat_co) and the adapter work: check the supply, its fiber and its CO-HV board.
Set point records stay NO_ALARM because the CO protocol does not answer sets (DESIGN.md §2).
Raw channels (every record of this device, from the registry)
Probe and copy come with RAS (ContextMenu.jsx).
Right-click on any value anywhere gives the same
Talks to the simulator control port,
not to the IOC. Hidden with real hardware.
SEVR and STAT are read as field PVs (record.SEVR, record.STAT). Time stamp from the IOC. A dead device shows INVALID and the time of its last good reply, never only an old number.
